## The Best of Rio de Janeiro in 7 Days: sightseeing and free time

This itinerary suits travelers who want to explore [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) at a relaxed pace without constantly changing hotels. **7 days and 6 nights** are spent staying in the city. The schedule includes three different excursion days: Corcovado, Sugarloaf Mountain and a boat trip in the [Angra dos Reis](/brazil/place/angra-dos-reis/) and [Ilha Grande](/brazil/place/ilha-grande/) area. Travelers have another two days entirely to themselves.

The idea is to see Rio's main panoramas while leaving room for personal interests: the ocean, museums, neighborhood walks or rest after an international flight. Unlike long itineraries through several regions of Brazil, this one does not involve a series of domestic flights.

## Day-by-day itinerary: one city, three excursions

| Day | Highlight |
|---|---|
| 1 | Arrival and hotel check-in |
| 2 | Corcovado and Christ the Redeemer |
| 3 | Sugarloaf Mountain |
| 4 | Tropical islands |
| 5–6 | Free days in Rio |
| 7 | Departure |

**Corcovado** offers a view over Rio: the train travels through Tijuca Forest to Christ the Redeemer. From the lookout, the arrangement of urban neighborhoods among mountains, bay and ocean is easy to appreciate. On this excursion day, visitors do not need to organize the entire journey to the summit themselves: the trip is part of the program.

**Sugarloaf Mountain** shows the city from another direction. The cable car rises via Morro da Urca, near [Praia Vermelha](/brazil/place/praia-vermelha/). It is a good place to see how closely city blocks sit beside granite peaks and the coastline. Corcovado and Sugarloaf complement each other, so giving them two separate days is more enjoyable than rushing through both.

**The tropical islands** are the focus of a boat excursion in the Angra dos Reis and Ilha Grande area. After two days of urban sightseeing, this brings a change from viewpoints to coastline and island scenery. The boat follows the route specified in the program; stops at arbitrary islands are not guaranteed in advance.

## What to do on the two free days

Days 5 and 6 have no mandatory excursions. You might spend a morning by the ocean, explore the city independently or divide the time between relaxation and additional activities.

For independent outings, choose your priorities in advance: beaches, architecture, museums or food. Free time also makes it easier to adjust for poor weather. Excursions to Vidigal and Petrópolis **are not included** in this tour, so they should not be assumed to be prepaid parts of the itinerary.

If you would rather add Iguaçu Falls and several nights in beachside Búzios, you will need a different route: the [Best of Brazil in 9 Days](/brazil/tour/best-of-brazil-9-days/) combines Rio with both destinations.

## Services already included in the tour

The package includes **6 nights** at the selected hotel or another of a similar category, breakfasts, excursions with a Russian-speaking guide, admission tickets for the scheduled excursions and the specified transfers. These inclusions make it possible to plan the main Rio days as a complete program.

International flights, tips, personal expenses and meals not specified in the program are paid for separately. Additional services should be assessed against what is actually listed in this particular tour.

## Accommodation and 2027 prices

Accommodation options for 2027 include **3-star, 4-star and 5-star hotels**. The price depends on hotel category and how many people share a room. The prices below are **per person in DBL (double) occupancy**; SGL and TRP have their own rates in the main program.

| DBL accommodation | USD per person |
|---|---:|
| B&B Copacabana 3*, Superior | 2039 |
| Arena Leme 4*, Standard | 2241 |
| Miramar by Windsor 5*, Standard | 2624 |

Because room-occupancy rates differ, DBL prices should not be compared directly with SGL or TRP without accounting for the number of guests. The exact hotel, any replacement of an equivalent category and room availability are confirmed when booking. It is easiest to start with the desired hotel category, then compare several accommodation options.

## Choose Rio or a longer journey across Brazil?

**Seven days in Rio** are especially convenient for a first introduction to the city, time by the ocean and a trip without domestic flights. There is no in-depth Amazon experience or visit to Iguaçu Falls on this itinerary, however. For a different mix, see [all Brazil tours](/brazil/tour/) or a [16-day journey including the Amazon](/brazil/tour/luxury-brazil-amazon-16-days/).

The seven-day format gives you more flexibility to divide time among attractions. First decide whether you want Rio itself with a boat excursion, or whether it is more important to include far-flung natural regions in the same journey.

## Frequently asked questions about the seven-day Rio tour

### Will I need to change hotels during the trip?

No. The program provides 6 nights in Rio de Janeiro at the selected hotel or one of an equivalent category.

### Which excursions are included?

Excursions to Corcovado, Sugarloaf Mountain and the tropical islands around Angra dos Reis and Ilha Grande.

### Are there days without excursions?

Yes. Days 5 and 6 are free for independent relaxation and walks.

### Is a 5-star hotel available?

Yes. The 2027 rates include Miramar by Windsor 5*, alongside 3-star and 4-star hotels.

### Are international flights included?

No. International air tickets must be paid for separately.

## Six days in Rio and the tropical islands: who is the express tour for?

The program combines sightseeing around [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) with a separate day on the water near [Angra dos Reis](/brazil/place/angra-dos-reis/) and [Ilha Grande](/brazil/place/ilha-grande/). Over **6 days and 5 nights**, you can enjoy Rio from two famous peaks, spend time near the ocean and exchange city streets for a green coastline.

All 5 overnight stays are planned in Rio. The island trip is organized as a day excursion with a return to the city hotel, so travelers do not need to move their luggage or change accommodation. The package includes guided sightseeing in Russian, admission tickets as specified in the itinerary, transfers, accommodation and breakfasts.

### How does this tour differ from four days in Rio?

The [4-day tour](/brazil/tour/rio-de-janeiro-four-days/) features similar main attractions, Corcovado and Sugarloaf Mountain. But only a portion of free time remains for additional outings, and the island excursion is not part of the standard program.

The six-day option includes **a separate excursion day around Angra dos Reis and Ilha Grande** and another completely free day after the main Rio sightseeing. It suits those who want to combine architecture, viewpoints, ocean scenery and relaxation without changing hotels every day.

## The city: Corcovado and Sugarloaf Mountain

Two main excursions give different perspectives on Rio's geography. A tourist train climbs Corcovado through [Tijuca Forest](/brazil/place/tijuca-national-park/), with Christ the Redeemer standing near the summit. Sugarloaf Mountain is reached by cable car with an intermediate stop on Morro da Urca.

Corcovado provides an elevated view of the city's outline, while Sugarloaf reveals the coastline, Guanabara Bay and surrounding hills from another angle. Tijuca's natural areas, Corcovado, the bays and Rio's developed waterfront form a unified cultural landscape inscribed by UNESCO. That is why these two viewpoints offer distinct experiences even on a short visit.

Excursions are conducted with a Russian-speaking guide. The tourist train ascent to Christ the Redeemer, the Sugarloaf cable car and the corresponding admission tickets are specified in the program.

## A day on the water: Angra dos Reis and Ilha Grande

Day 4 is dedicated to a boat trip near Angra dos Reis and Ilha Grande. The water excursion is scheduled approximately **10:00–16:00**, with a driver providing transport from Rio and back after the tour.

This shoreline is called Costa Verde, or the "Green Coast." Forested hills descend toward the bays and islands create a completely different scene from Copacabana and Ipanema's urban beaches. The change of surroundings is the key experience: following city panoramas, visitors discover the water, lush greenery and island shores.

However, **the island day must not be taken as a promise of landing at a particular beach or of a fixed amount of swimming time**. Stops and their actual order are clarified for the chosen boat excursion. Conditions at sea depend on the weather and water, so ask about the arrangements for postponement or route changes before traveling.

Read more about the coast on our [Angra dos Reis](/brazil/place/angra-dos-reis/) and [Ilha Grande](/brazil/place/ilha-grande/) pages. Their natural geography differs from [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/), although all overnight stays remain in the city.

## How sightseeing and relaxation are divided

The opening days cover arrival and an introduction to the city, followed by visits to Corcovado and Sugarloaf. Day 4 is the journey to the tropical islands. **Day 5 is entirely free** for the beach, walks around the city or relaxation at the hotel. Day 6 is set aside for the airport transfer.

One practical detail deserves attention. Of the 6 calendar days, one is an arrival day and another a departure day. Choose international flights so that the free day stays genuinely free and the island excursion is not squeezed between a late arrival and an early departure.

The water excursion adds variety, but requires more effort than walking along an urban promenade: you will travel from Rio, board a boat, spend several hours on the water and return by transfer. If you prefer the most relaxed possible trip, especially with children or susceptibility to seasickness, discuss this aspect before selecting the tour.

## Hotels, rates and included services

We offer 2027 rates in USD **per person**. There are 3-star, 4-star and 5-star hotels with triple (TRP), double (DBL) and single (SGL) occupancy. All options include 5 nights in Rio and breakfasts.

| Example accommodation | Price per person |
| --- | --- |
| B&B Copacabana 3*, TRP | $1564 |
| B&B Copacabana 3*, DBL | $1886 |
| Arena Leme 4*, DBL | $2055 |
| Miramar by Windsor 5*, DBL | $2374 |

These are four of nine available rates; the complete table is in the tour's main pricing section. A hotel of equivalent category may be used under the program terms. The cheaper TRP rate should not be compared directly with DBL, since the number of people sharing the room differs.

Included services are accommodation and breakfasts, scheduled excursions, admission tickets and specified transfers. **International flights, tips, personal expenses and meals beyond the inclusions** are paid for separately. The price should not be assumed to cover every restaurant meal or independent activity on the free day.

## When to choose a longer trip

The six-day itinerary works well as a self-contained introduction to Rio and the coastline. If you want to visit two very different natural regions, consider the [8-day Rio–Iguaçu itinerary](/brazil/tour/rio-iguazu-jewish-heritage-8-days/): it includes the waterfalls on both the Brazilian and Argentine sides, but requires a domestic flight and a hotel change. You can also browse [Brazilian beach holidays](/interests/beach-holidays/tours/brazil/) and the [countrywide tour catalog](/brazil/tour/).

## Frequently asked questions about the Best of Rio Express tour

### Are the islands included in the basic price?

Yes. The boat trip around Angra dos Reis and Ilha Grande is an included excursion day. The exact boat stops are confirmed separately.

### Do we need to change hotels for the island trip?

No. All 5 nights are planned in Rio, with a return to the same city after the boat excursion.

### Is there a day with no excursions at all?

Yes. Day 5 is free for beach relaxation, walks or independent activities.

### Which price should I compare: $1564 or $1886?

$1564 is the lowest 3-star TRP rate, while $1886 is the DBL rate in the same category. Choose according to the number of people who will share a room.

## Agribusiness in Brazil: a 14-day itinerary from business meetings to Iguaçu

This tour combines **14 days and 13 nights** across [São Paulo](/brazil/place/sao-paulo/), [Ribeirão Preto](/brazil/place/ribeirao-preto/), the [Amazon](/brazil/place/manaus-amazon/), [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/) and [Iguaçu](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/). The opening stage includes two days devoted to an agribusiness professional program; the second part introduces the group to Brazil's natural and cultural destinations.

For a delegation, the main benefit is combining professional networking with a sightseeing itinerary. However, **the specific business event in Ribeirão Preto still needs confirmation**. Before booking, its dates, participation format, registration terms and schedule of business meetings must be established.

## Ribeirão Preto: plans for the business days

After arriving in São Paulo, guests check into their hotel. Day 2 includes a guided sightseeing tour covering historic and modern districts, followed by a transfer to Ribeirão Preto.

Days 3–4 focus on agricultural technologies, biotechnology, sustainable food production and exchanging experience among industry representatives. These are the topics of the business component, not a confirmed list of speakers or companies to be visited.

Ribeirão Preto lies in São Paulo state, a region associated with Brazilian agriculture and the food industry. When selecting an event, consider the participants' specializations, opportunities for professional meetings and how well the program matches the delegation's objectives.

One important correction: **IFAMA 2027 takes place on June 20–25, 2027, in Lima, Peru**. Registration for IFAMA in Brazil is not included. If the journey is meant to revolve specifically around IFAMA, the business portion will need to be planned differently.

## Fourteen-day schedule: the main stops

| Days | Stage |
|---|---|
| 1–2 | São Paulo and Ribeirão Preto |
| 3–4 | Agribusiness and business meetings |
| 5–6 | Manaus and an Amazon lodge |
| 7–9 | Rio de Janeiro |
| 10–12 | Iguaçu in Brazil and Argentina |
| 13–14 | São Paulo and departure |

The itinerary involves several domestic flights and overland transfers. Participants should consider not only the nights spent in each location but also actual connection times, ground journeys and the international border crossing.

## The Amazon: lodge, river and important flight restrictions

Day 5 includes a flight to Manaus and a transfer to an Amazon lodge. Dinner and activities on the property are planned for the evening, with possible forest walks and fishing. The next day is devoted to a boat program, a visit to caboclo residents, a jungle walk and encounters with pink river dolphins.

**Amazon excursions take place in a group with an English-speaking guide.** The format of any interaction with dolphins is agreed before booking, and wild-animal sightings depend on actual natural conditions.

Two specific timing rules apply: for the standard transfer, travelers must **arrive in Manaus before 16:00** and schedule their departure flight **no earlier than 14:30**. Otherwise, private transport to or from the lodge costs extra. These conditions should be considered before purchasing domestic flights.

## Rio de Janeiro: two sightseeing tours and a helicopter

After the Amazon, the group flies to [Rio](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/). The plan includes ascending Sugarloaf Mountain via Urca and a tour of the old center. The next day, a train travels through [Tijuca](/brazil/place/tijuca-national-park/) National Park forest to Corcovado and the Christ the Redeemer statue.

These excursions reveal the city from different directions. One highlights the coastal panorama and bay; the other offers a look over urban neighborhoods from a high viewpoint.

A **30-minute helicopter flight** is listed as a possible add-on. Its price, departure helipad and inclusion in the final quote are agreed separately. Mentioning the flight in the day's description does not mean it has already been paid for.

## Iguaçu: why two excursion days are needed

On the Brazilian side, the program includes waterfall viewpoints, Macuco Safari with a boat component and the Bird Park. These are distinct activities: panoramic platforms, getting close to the falling water and a visit to a separate natural attraction.

On day 12, the group crosses the border and travels to [Puerto Iguazú](/argentina/place/puerto-iguazu/). Argentine trails and viewing platforms reveal the cascades from another side, including the Devil's Throat area.

**Iguaçu lies in two countries.** Visiting the Argentine park requires valid documents and compliance with Argentina's entry rules. For a multinational delegation, these requirements are checked separately for each participant's nationality. Admission-ticket inclusions are clarified before the trip.

## Inclusions and exclusions: understanding the offer

The program provides **13 nights of accommodation** in hotels and a lodge with breakfasts, chauffeured transfers, privately guided excursions in São Paulo, Rio and Iguaçu, group excursions in the Amazon, and dinner on arrival at the lodge.

**The price excludes** international and domestic flights, insurance, tips, personal expenses and extra private transfers in Manaus when flights fall outside the specified times. Business-event registration fees, admission tickets and helicopter-flight terms are also agreed separately.

No fixed program price has yet been established: dates, hotels and the business agenda affect the quote. A delegation should request one detailed estimate showing the industry event, flights, accommodation, excursions and guiding services separately.

## Who this trip suits

The itinerary is particularly useful to companies and professional associations wishing to combine their work with an overview of Brazil. If business meetings are not a priority, compare [regular Brazil tours](/brazil/tour/); if nature is the main goal, explore [wildlife and ecological itineraries](/interests/wildlife/tours/brazil/).

Before confirming, the group needs to establish the delegation's composition and nationalities, working language, meeting objectives, dates and acceptable travel times. This makes it possible to develop a realistic program rather than a superficial combination of conference and sightseeing days.

## Frequently asked questions about the Brazil business tour

### Is participation in IFAMA 2027 included?

No. IFAMA 2027 takes place in Lima, Peru. The identity and participation conditions of an event in Ribeirão Preto must be agreed separately.

### Which flights cost extra?

International and domestic flights are listed among excluded services. It is especially important to choose flight times that work with the Amazon lodge transfers.

### Is the Argentine side of Iguaçu included?

It appears on day 12. Border-crossing documents will be required, and the included admission tickets are confirmed with the quote.

### Are all excursions private?

No. Excursions in São Paulo, Rio and Iguaçu are private, while those around Manaus are group outings with an English-speaking guide.

### How long is the itinerary?

14 days and 13 nights. Exact dates and accommodation are arranged together with the business program.

## Brazil in 12 days: Rio, Iguaçu, the Amazon and beach time in Búzios

The program combines four distinct parts of Brazil. The first days focus on [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/), with the Sugarloaf cable car and the train to Christ the Redeemer. Next come [Iguaçu Falls](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/) from the Brazilian and Argentine sides, the [Amazon near Manaus](/brazil/place/manaus-amazon/) with a lodge stay, and finally free days on the beaches of [Búzios](/brazil/place/buzios/).

At **12 days and 11 nights**, the trip combines famous attractions and two very different natural regions with resort relaxation. The price of such variety is several domestic flights, whose order and connection times matter much more than on a journey limited to one or two cities.

## How the stages are divided

| Days | Program |
|---|---|
| 1–4 | Rio, two sightseeing excursions, free day |
| 5–6 | Brazilian and Argentine sides of Iguaçu |
| 7–8 | Manaus, an Amazon lodge and excursions |
| 9–11 | Flight to Rio, Búzios, time by the ocean |
| 12 | Transfer from Búzios to Rio airport |

There is a separate free day in Rio on day 4. Optional activities include the Botanical Garden, [Angra dos Reis](/brazil/place/angra-dos-reis/) and [Petrópolis](/brazil/place/petropolis/), but they must not be assumed to be part of the paid itinerary.

At Iguaçu, the arrival day includes sightseeing on the Brazilian side, followed by an excursion across the border to the [Argentine side near Puerto Iguazú](/argentina/place/puerto-iguazu/). Border documents depend on each participant's nationality; part of the route enters another country even though the tour is principally a Brazilian one.

## The Amazon: how these days differ

After the falls, travelers fly to Manaus and head to a nature lodge. The Amazon section includes river outings, piranha fishing, meeting a caboclo family and learning about life in the rainforest. Conditions change substantially: excursions take place on rivers and in the forest, and some are conducted **in a group with an English-speaking guide**, unlike the Russian-language tours on the main itinerary.

On day 8, you go fishing and visit a caboclo village. Optional experiences include seeing where the Rio Negro and Solimões rivers meet and other river outings. Optional services and their prices must not be confused with the core itinerary.

**Critical flight-connection condition:** travelers must arrive in Manaus **before 16:00** and schedule departure **after 14:30**. At other times, private transfers to or from the lodge may incur extra charges. When purchasing domestic tickets, these requirements matter more than choosing the lowest fare alone.

## Why Búzios comes after the Amazon

After returning from Manaus to Rio, day 9 continues by road transfer to [Búzios](/brazil/place/buzios/). Days 10 and 11 are free, without a packed sightseeing program. Travelers can relax on the beaches, choose boat trips or spend time independently.

That is particularly welcome after extensive transfers and two busy nature-focused stages. However, if the main goal is several days of observing wildlife in the Amazon, the lodge receives less time than the combined city and resort sections. It is worth considering this trade-off beforehand.

## Included services and main additional expenses

The tour price includes hotel accommodation, excursions with a Russian-speaking guide, group outings with an English-speaking guide in Manaus and transfers according to the itinerary. Optional excursions, meals and drinks during transfers, and **domestic flights Rio–Iguaçu–Manaus–Rio** are paid for separately. The estimated cost of these flights is **from $990**.

The itinerary was prepared for 2026, but there are no fixed departure dates. Before traveling in the future, confirm the available program and check that the chosen flights meet the Manaus transfer requirements. Changing the stage sequence without checking these connections would be risky.

## Practical preparations

At Iguaçu, waterproof protection for electronics and shoes with reliable grip are useful. For the Amazon, pack clothing suitable for a humid tropical climate, insect protection and a small waterproof bag for belongings. Check domestic carry-on allowances in advance: with several flights, baggage restrictions become more significant.

Entry-document requirements for the short visit to the Argentine side of Iguaçu must be clarified separately. When choosing optional activities in the Amazon, distinguish confirmed inclusions from activities offered on request, especially those involving encounters with wildlife.

## When to choose a shorter itinerary

If your main interests are urban panoramas and the waterfalls, the [6-day Rio and Iguaçu tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-rio-iguazu-6-days/) omits Manaus and the resort finale. For a holiday combining Rio with beach relaxation and fewer flights, there is an [8-day Rio and Búzios option](/brazil/tour/brazil-rio-buzios-8-days/).

The twelve-day route is better suited to travelers who want to experience both the Amazon and Iguaçu on one journey and are prepared to plan complicated flight logistics in advance.

## Frequently asked questions about the Amazon and Iguaçu tour

### How much time is spent in the Amazon?

On day 7, travelers arrive in Manaus and check into the lodge; day 8 features nature excursions; on day 9 they fly to Rio.

### Why do arrival times in Manaus matter?

The program requires arrival before 16:00 and departure after 14:30; otherwise, transfers to and from the lodge may cost extra.

### Are domestic flights included?

No. They are listed among additional expenses, with an estimated cost from $990 for the Rio–Iguaçu–Manaus–Rio sequence.

### What language are Amazon excursions conducted in?

Group excursions in Manaus are led by an English-speaking guide. The main excursions in the other sections have Russian-speaking guiding.

### Are there free days by the ocean?

Yes. Days 10 and 11 are free in Búzios.

## Rio, Iguaçu and Porto de Galinhas: combining sightseeing and beach relaxation

This [Brazil tour](/brazil/tour/) begins with the main attractions of [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/), continues to [Iguaçu](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/) and concludes on the country's northeastern coastline. **8 days and 7 nights** allow travelers to experience three very different sides of Brazil without a long journey through all its regions.

The main focus of the final stage is [Porto de Galinhas](/brazil/place/porto-de-galinhas/), a resort near [Recife](/brazil/place/recife/). Here you can relax by the ocean, visit natural reef pools and choose water activities according to the weather.

## Sugarloaf and Corcovado: the first excursion days

After arriving in Rio, the itinerary includes a sightseeing tour featuring Sugarloaf Mountain and the historic center. The following day is devoted to Corcovado and the statue of Christ the Redeemer. These viewpoints show the city from different directions and reveal the location of its beaches, bay and mountain ranges.

The city portion is relatively short. Beach relaxation in Rio is not the main focus: more time is reserved for visiting the waterfalls and continuing to the coast of Pernambuco.

## Iguaçu: two sides of the falls in two days

Day 4 includes a flight to Foz do Iguaçu and a visit to the Brazilian side, with sweeping views of the cascades and tropical forest. Day 5 is set aside for the Argentine side, where trails pass closer to certain sections of the falling water.

Although listed among Brazil tours, the itinerary includes [Puerto Iguazú](/argentina/place/puerto-iguazu/) and a border crossing. Entry documents and conditions must be checked for all travelers' nationalities. Trail conditions can change after heavy rain and high water levels.

## Porto de Galinhas: natural pools and tides

From Iguaçu, a domestic flight takes travelers via Recife to the ocean. Porto de Galinhas is famous for shallow pools between reefs, most visible **at low tide**. The best time to watch fish and take boat trips therefore depends on the tide timetable as well as free hours in the itinerary.

Visitors can relax on sandy beaches, swim and choose water sports. Surfing and calm swimming conditions differ along the coastline. Suitable footwear and respect for marine conservation rules are helpful around reef pools.

Only items listed among the confirmed tour services are included; separate sporting activities and optional excursions should not be assumed to be prepaid.

## Tour price and travel logistics

The base price is **$3205**. It includes accommodation at the selected hotels or similar properties, excursions, admission tickets and chauffeured transfers. The **Rio–Iguaçu–Recife domestic flight route** is paid for separately. Optional excursions, meals and drinks during transfers are also listed as additional expenses.

An important distinction from the [São Paulo–Búzios itinerary](/brazil/tour/brazil-sao-paulo-to-buzios/) is that this tour ends with beaches in the northeast, a different climate and coastal region. The journey is also 4 days shorter.

When comparing [beach tours in Brazil](/interests/beach-holidays/tours/brazil/), consider not just the number of nights by the sea but also the character of the beach, rainy season and domestic flight schedules.

## Frequently asked questions about the Porto de Galinhas tour

### When is the best time to see the natural pools?

They are most visible at low tide. The precise timing changes daily with local conditions.

### Does the tour include the Argentine side of Iguaçu?

Yes. A separate day is reserved for visiting the Argentine side and crossing the border.

### Are domestic flights included in the price?

No. Flights between Rio, Iguaçu and Recife are listed as separately payable services.
